articles.title: US actress Selma Blair arrested after flight altercation
articles.summary:
📰 기술 관련 뉴스
📢 US actress Selma Blair arrested after flight altercation
articles.content: US media said that Blair punched one flight attendant and bit another. "Selma experienced a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct," a representative for Blair said. "Upon landing, she received immediate medical attention and is currently in stable condition."

articles.title: US says it opposes Chinese 'coercion', after Belize, Paraguay ministers sanctioned
articles.summary:
📰 장관, 기술, 관광 관련 뉴스
📢 US says it opposes Chinese 'coercion', after Belize, Paraguay ministers sanction...
articles.content: Paraguay and Belize are two of just 12 countries ‌to maintain formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan. The sanctions are largely symbolic because ministers from Taiwan's diplomatic allies generally do not travel to China. Beijing has previously imposed similar measures mainly on Western politicians for their support of democratically governed Taiwan. "The Trump Administration opposes coercion and aggression by China ‌against countries in our hemisphere ⁠for exercising their sovereign rights," State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a statement.
